crossRefs.note: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will…
For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you.…
For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says Yahweh.
“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind…
For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which…
Let the prophets speak, two or three, and let the others discern.
Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
“I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who…
Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists…
For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
“Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or, ‘There,’ don’t believe it.
Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing…
But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

translations.web: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
translations.bsb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
translations.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
translations.asv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
